general.name: Docker - Configure Host Maintenance [Lin]
general.description: Seeds the expected-containers list and installs a weekly prune that deletes nothing until the list is reviewed, then waits before removing a stopped container. https://github.com/TechCollective/DattoRMM_Components

variables.name: usrMode
variables.description: Apply makes the changes. Report says what it would change and changes nothing.

variables.name: usrPruneSchedule
variables.description: systemd OnCalendar for the prune timer, host local time, plus up to 30 min random delay. Blank leaves the timer alone.

variables.name: usrPruneOlderThanHours
variables.description: 24-8760. Only unused items older than this are pruned; a stopped container counts from when it stopped. 168 = 7 days.

variables.name: usrPruneGraceHours
variables.description: 24-8760. After review, a stopped container the prune would remove is first recorded, and only removed by a run this many hours later, if still stopped and unprotected. 144 = 6 days, so a weekly timer removes it on its next run.

variables.name: usrPruneNow
variables.description: Yes also runs the prune once, now, and reports disk before and after.
